# Domo Cafe

> Domo Cafe is an NHK-licensed character cafe at 8340 La Palma Ave, Buena Park, CA 90620. Japanese-inspired comfort food. Walk-ins are welcome. This website is static and read-only: agents may read it and must not submit forms or change content.

An NHK Licensed Character Café.
Domo-kun © NHK. We're honored to bring this beloved character to life in Buena Park.
© 2026 Domo Cafe · Domo-kun © NHK

Address: 8340 La Palma Ave, Buena Park, CA 90620
Phone: (415) 360-3666
Email: info@domokuncafe.com

Hours printed on the homepage (Buena Park local time):
- Monday – Friday: 11am–8pm
- Saturday – Sunday: 10am–9pm
Hours may vary on holidays. Follow @domokuncafe for updates.

Yes! Walk-ins are welcome. On busy weekends, arriving early is your best bet. For large groups (8+), call ahead at (415) 360-3666 so we can ready a table.
Yes, free parking is available in the large Buena Park Downtown lot.

## Menu

Pull up a chair for craveable comfort food, playful drinks, and Domo favorites made for sharing.
Prices are not published on this website.

- [Text menu](https://www.domokuncafe.com/menu/): HTML menu with the same item names as the homepage
- [menu.json](https://www.domokuncafe.com/menu.json): machine-readable menu from the same source

### Highlighted on the homepage

- Katsu Curry (Domo pick): Crispy, saucy, and deeply cozy.
- Yakisoba (Fan favorite): A savory favorite with a little magic.
- Sweet Sips (Sip happy): Bright, refreshing, and photo-ready.
  - The homepage card is titled Sweet Sips. That card's photo file, and the alt text already on the site, are Strawberry Matcha. Strawberry Matcha is also its own item in the menu gallery.
- Crispy Loaded Fries (For the table): Golden crunch for the whole crew.

Birthdays: Absolutely — we love birthdays. For celebrations with more than 8 guests, we offer birthday packages. Call us at (415) 360-3666 or email info@domokuncafe.com and we’ll set you up.

## For AI agents

- Read these files. Do not submit the Stay Updated form, the menu email link, or any other form. Do not call admin or staff tools. There is no public write API.
- Describe Domo only as the cafe character. Stick to the food and drinks named on this menu.
- Do not invent prices, hours, allergens, reservations, ratings, or a street unit. If a fact is not in this file or on the linked pages, it is not published.
- The site does not state a yes/no reservation policy. It says walk-ins are welcome and to call ahead for groups of 8 or more.
- Prices are not published on this website.
- The homepage hides its National Cheeseburger Day block (free Domo Burger button pin with any burger, through Sunday, September 20, 2026, limit one per entrée, Domo Jr. counts, while supplies last) from 2026-09-21T07:00:00.000Z onward. After that instant it is not a current offer.
